import requests, re, time
import pandas as pd, numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
from sklearn.discriminant_analysis import LinearDiscriminantAnalysis as LDA
from sklearn.preprocessing import StandardScaler
from sklearn.model_selection import StratifiedKFold
from sklearn.metrics import roc_auc_score
t0=time.time(); B_="https://rest.uniprot.org"
def search(q,f):
    o=[];u=f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search?query={requests.utils.quote(q)}&fields={f}&format=json&size=500"
    while u:
        r=requests.get(u,timeout=60);r.raise_for_status();o+=r.json()["results"]
        m=re.search(r'<([^>]+)>; rel="next"',r.headers.get("Link",""));u=m.group(1) if m else None
    return o
SUBS=["P05067","P51693","Q06481","P46531","Q04721","Q9UM47","Q99466","Q15303","P12830","P19022",
"P16070","Q07954","P43146","O00548","P78504","Q9Y219","P29323","P54764","P98172","P52799","Q02297",
"P07333","P14778","P27930","P08138","P14679","P16150","Q13740","P13591","P15529","P78423","Q9H2A7",
"Q14114","P98155","Q15223","O00533","P32004","P10912","P48551","P08887","O60939","Q9UEF7","P16422",
"Q92673","O75129","Q14126","P19438","O75509","Q9NZC2","P17948","O75581","Q9Y5Y7"]
F="accession,gene_primary,sequence,ft_transmem,ft_signal,lit_pubmed_id"
BG=search('(organism_id:9606) AND (reviewed:true) AND (cc_scl_term:SL-9905)',F)
SU=requests.get(f"{B_}/uniprotkb/search",params={"query":" OR ".join(f"accession:{a}" for a in SUBS),
   "fields":F,"format":"json","size":500},timeout=60).json()["results"]
KD={'A':1.8,'R':-4.5,'N':-3.5,'D':-3.5,'C':2.5,'Q':-3.5,'E':-3.5,'G':-0.4,'H':-3.2,'I':4.5,'L':3.8,
    'K':-3.9,'M':1.9,'F':2.8,'P':-1.6,'S':-0.8,'T':-0.7,'W':-0.9,'Y':-1.3,'V':4.2}
def ft(e):
    s_=e["sequence"]["value"];tms=[x for x in e.get("features",[]) if x["type"]=="Transmembrane"]
    if len(tms)!=1: return None
    a=tms[0]["location"]["start"]["value"];b=tms[0]["location"]["end"]["value"]
    if not a or not b: return None
    sg=[x for x in e.get("features",[]) if x["type"]=="Signal"]
    se=(sg[0]["location"]["end"]["value"] or 0) if sg else 0
    tm=s_[a-1:b];jx=s_[max(0,a-11):a-1];jc=s_[b:b+10]
    fr=lambda q,s:(sum(q.count(c) for c in s)/len(q) if q else np.nan);g=e.get("genes") or [{}]
    return dict(acc=e["primaryAccession"],gene=(g[0].get("geneName") or {}).get("value"),
      ecto_len=a-1-se,tm_len=b-a+1,cyto_len=len(s_)-b,tm_GP=fr(tm,"GP"),tm_destab=fr(tm,"GPSTAND"),
      tm_gravy=float(np.mean([KD.get(c,0) for c in tm])),tm_beta=fr(tm,"IVT"),
      jmex_acidic=fr(jx,"DE"),jmcy_basic=fr(jc,"KR"),
      n_sxxxs=len(re.findall(r'(?=[GAS]...[GAS])',tm)),n_refs=len(e.get("references",[])))
S=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,SU) if x]).assign(label=1)
Bg=pd.DataFrame([x for x in map(ft,BG) if x]).assign(label=0); Bg=Bg[~Bg.acc.isin(set(S.acc))]
D=pd.concat([S,Bg],ignore_index=True).dropna().reset_index(drop=True)
FE=["ecto_len","tm_len","tm_GP","tm_destab","tm_gravy","tm_beta","cyto_len","jmex_acidic","jmcy_basic","n_sxxxs"]
Xs=StandardScaler().fit_transform(D[FE].values); refs=D.n_refs.values
skf=list(StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0).split(Xs,D.label.values))
def cvauc(lab):
    p=np.zeros(len(lab))
    for tr,te in StratifiedKFold(5,shuffle=True,random_state=0).split(Xs,lab):
        p[te]=LDA().fit(Xs[tr],lab[tr]).predict_proba(Xs[te])[:,1]
    return roc_auc_score(lab,p)
obs=cvauc(D.label.values); nsub=int(D.label.sum())
print(f"prep {time.time()-t0:.1f}s | observed CV AUC (LDA, same 10 features) = {obs:.3f}  n_sub={nsub} n_bg={len(D)-nsub}")
bgidx=D.index[D.label==0].to_numpy()
edges=np.unique(np.quantile(refs[bgidx],np.linspace(0,1,11)))[1:-1]
sb=np.digitize(refs[D.label==1],edges); bb=np.digitize(refs[bgidx],edges)
pools={b:bgidx[bb==b] for b in np.unique(bb)}
rng=np.random.default_rng(1); matched=[];randm=[];NS=300
for _ in range(NS):
    pick=set()
    for b in sb:
        pl=pools.get(b,bgidx); c=rng.choice(pl)
        while c in pick: c=rng.choice(pl)
        pick.add(c)
    l=np.zeros(len(D),int); l[list(pick)]=1; matched.append(cvauc(l))
    l2=np.zeros(len(D),int); l2[rng.choice(bgidx,nsub,replace=False)]=1; randm.append(cvauc(l2))
matched=np.array(matched);randm=np.array(randm); p_m=(np.sum(matched>=obs)+1)/(NS+1)
print(f"\n=== Ascertainment-matched null, {NS} resamples ===")
print(f"real reported substrates                  AUC = {obs:.3f}")
print(f"pseudo-substrates matched on study intensity  = {matched.mean():.3f} [95% {np.percentile(matched,2.5):.3f}-{np.percentile(matched,97.5):.3f}]   p = {p_m:.3f}")
print(f"pseudo-substrates random                      = {randm.mean():.3f} [95% {np.percentile(randm,2.5):.3f}-{np.percentile(randm,97.5):.3f}]")
print(f"total {time.time()-t0:.1f}s")
fig,ax=plt.subplots(figsize=(8.6,5))
ax.hist(randm,bins=25,alpha=.6,color="#8c9bab",label=f"random background labels (mean {randm.mean():.2f})")
ax.hist(matched,bins=25,alpha=.75,color="#2e86c1",label=f"labels matched on study intensity only (mean {matched.mean():.2f})")
ax.axvline(obs,color="#c0392b",lw=2.5,label=f"real reported substrates ({obs:.2f})")
ax.set_xlabel("5-fold cross-validated AUC, 10 proposed substrate-determinant features")
ax.set_ylabel("resamples"); ax.legend(fontsize=9)
ax.set_title("Sets of proteins matched only on how often they have been studied reach the same\n"
             f"substrate-feature AUC as the real reported substrates (p = {p_m:.2f})",fontsize=11)
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
